page.content:
Three wars with Carthage that made Rome a Mediterranean power.

How Punic Wars connects

  • Location: Carthage — The Punic Wars were fought against Carthage.
  • Character: Hannibal — Hannibal was Carthage's general in the Second Punic War.
  • Faction: Roman Republic — The Republic became a Mediterranean empire through the Punic Wars.
  • Event: Battle of Cannae — Cannae was the nadir of the Second Punic War.
  • Character: Scipio Africanus — Scipio Africanus ended the Second Punic War in Africa.

What is Punic Wars?

The Punic Wars (264–146 BCE) ran from Sicily through Hannibal's invasion to the sack of Carthage. They created overseas provinces and a soldier-class the later Republic could not reabsorb.

Key threads lead to Carthage, Hannibal, Roman Republic, Battle of Cannae and Scipio Africanus.
